subject: PICTURE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-19 (kb/Work PB491). GR12's aliasing - every reference to '+' applies to the POSITIVE phrase's literal and every reference to '-' to the NEGATIVE phrase's - now reaches BOTH arms it governs, not only fixed insertion with a one-character literal. The FLOATING arm (13.18.40.5 rule 6, Table 9) exists: rule 6's first sentence lists 'the extended editing sign control symbols, if specified' among the floating insertion symbols, so a FOR-phrase character-1 appearing twice or more is a floating string, and PictureComposition.MarkFloating now takes those letters as floating candidates instead of treating every character-1 as transparent. The MULTI-CHARACTER arm of Table 8 exists: EditRule carries literal-2/literal-3 as STRINGS and CobolEdit materializes them at GR14 'es' width. The two GREEN tests that pinned the GAP (MultiCharLiteral_StagedGap0899, FloatingCharacter1_StagedGap0899) are DELETED and replaced by the images Annex D.24 states. MEASURED: PIC L999.99 EDITING L FOR NEGATIVE IS "DEBIT " renders 'DEBIT 123.45' for -123.45 and six spaces then '123.45' for +123.45, SIZE 12; PIC LLLL9.99F with "(" and ")" renders ' (123.45)', SIZE 9; PIC LLLL9.99 with "DEBIT " has SIZE 13, which is the arithmetic D.24 states outright.
